basePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D RPG character sprite sheet with transparent alpha, for a medieval castle viewed top-down at a steep 45-degree elevated camera, SNES-inspired detailed pixel illustration. Generate ONE character's complete 12-pose sheet. Reference image is the existing character portrait: preserve recognizable face, age, hair, skin, clothing, colors, headwear and jewelry, translating to FULL BODY sprites seen from ABOVE. Do not reproduce the portrait grid.
Layout: exactly THREE equal-width columns by FOUR equal-height rows, portrait canvas 1024x1536. Each cell contains only one complete figure. Row 1: facing SOUTH toward viewer. Row 2: facing WEST left. Row 3: facing EAST right. Row 4: facing NORTH away, showing back of head and back of outfit, NO FACE. In EACH row columns are: 1 standing neutral feet together; 2 walking left foot forward; 3 walking right foot forward. Twelve figures of the SAME character, precisely aligned, consistent size and costume across every frame. All figures centered horizontally in their cells, feet on the same baseline within each row, occupy about 70% of cell height; generous transparent margins. Top of head and shoulders clearly visible in ALL directions including side directions; foreshortened torso suitable for overhead castle floor. Refined warm medieval pixel-art shading, crisp contours, natural adult proportions (not chibi), detailed small readable costume. Neutral warm lighting same in all directions. Real transparent background with alpha, no ground, no cast shadows, no grid, no text, no labels, no extra props outside character, no frame or border. Keep weapons/accessories completely inside each cell.
